verdict.rationale: Pylon documents a built-in Assist Agent you can message to investigate issues, draft replies and perform actions. Background Agents run work asynchronously, and you can assign issues to the AI agent just as you would to a teammate, backed by Ask AI, Skills, User Memories and an issue log for monitoring outcomes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as documented (all evidence is vendor docs).
